annotations.title: Upload a photo to an Evite event album

description: Upload a photo to an Evite event's shared photo gallery. This really adds the photo to the event album. Needs your guest_id on the event (from evite_list_guests). Pass the image as exactly one of: path (a file in EVITE_UPLOAD_DIR — local installs only), inline (base64 — small files), or blob_key. On the hosted connector, use the slot flow: call evite_upload_slots, PUT the file to the uploadUrl with its curl command, then pass the returned blobKey here as blob_key. JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP/HEIC, max 20 MB. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

blob_key.description: The blobKey of an upload slot from evite_upload_slots, after the file was PUT to its uploadUrl. The hosted way to send a photo of any size. Deleted once Evite accepts the photo; kept if the upload fails, so a retry can reuse it.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

guest_id.description: Your guest id on the event (guestId from evite_list_guests — your own row, guestType host/cohost/guest).

inline.description: The image itself, base64-encoded. Works everywhere; best for a small photo.

content_base64.description: The image bytes, standard base64 (a "data:image/…;base64," prefix and line breaks are tolerated).

filename.description: Filename to store the photo under — a bare name with an image extension, e.g. "photo.jpg".

mimetype.description: Override the image mimetype (otherwise inferred from the filename). Must match the file contents.

path.description: LOCAL INSTALLS ONLY. Path to the image file, inside the upload directory (EVITE_UPLOAD_DIR, default ~/Downloads/evite-mcp; a relative path is resolved there, a leading ~ is expanded; hidden files are refused). Refused on the hosted connector — use blob_key (via evite_upload_slots) or inline there.

name: evite_upload_photo
